page.layout: One printed title page, centred within a decorative woodcut border. No running head, page number, catchword or signature.
page.notes: The title page is set in a faded, low-contrast print, and the scan shows show-through from the reverse side, so most lines below the Præses name are unreadable. The readings of the Roman-numbered theses (I–V), the names of the Præses and respondents, and the printer and date line at the foot are not certain; only the words marked above are reasonably clear. The Greek and Hebrew letters are not present on this page. The line "IOHANNE WOLFIO" is a likely reading of the large name line and should be checked against a sharper scan.
